podcast.body: Appearing on the 1983 album "Batastrophe," this track was presented as an example of Speseman's sound. "It's called Kiss Kiss, Bang Bang."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song by Specimen was highlighted as representative of their sound and their role as founders of the influential Batcave club, considered "ground zero for Goth proper." "Specimen and kiss kiss bang bang and founders at the legendary and highly influential Batcave club in West End London, ground zero for Goth proper."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
